name: Westin Lima Hotel & Convention Center
insider_take: Lima's towering luxury landmark where modern sophistication meets Peru's ancient soul in the heart of San Isidro's financial district.
whats_special: This 30-story architectural marvel is Lima's tallest hotel, offering panoramic views of the Pacific Ocean and the Andes Mountains. The hotel sits in San Isidro, Lima's upscale "Garden District," surrounded by pre-Columbian olive groves that are over 400 years old. The property features Peru's largest hotel convention center and houses authentic Peruvian art collections throughout its sleek interiors.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 20+ for stunning sunset views over the Pacific, and time your stay during Lima's dry season (May-September) when the city's notorious garúa fog lifts for clearer mountain vistas.
dont_miss: The nearby Huaca Huallamarca pyramid (just 3 blocks away) - a 2,000-year-old adobe temple that predates Machu Picchu. Stroll through El Olivar Park's ancient olive trees, then explore the trendy Barranco district (15 minutes away) for Lima's vibrant street art scene and oceanfront malecón boardwalk.
pros: Prime Miraflores location with easy access to Lima's top dining, shopping, and cultural attractions
Iconic rooftop pool and bar offering stunning panoramic views of the Pacific Ocean and Lima skyline
World-class Heavenly Spa and wellness facilities including signature Westin Heavenly Beds for exceptional rest
Outstanding on-site dining featuring fresh Peruvian-inspired cuisine at multiple restaurants and bars
Expansive convention and meeting facilities making it ideal for both business travelers and large-scale events
cons: Urban city-center setting may not suit travelers seeking a quieter or resort-style escape
Premium pricing reflects luxury positioning, which may place it above budget-conscious travelers
